transcript: Speaker A (Boy): My name is Shobhit. I have come to the school to take admission in class 9. My favorite subject is maths. I like playing games, watching movies, and talking to new people. Speaker B (Teacher): अरे वाह शोभित बेटा! 8th पास होकर इतनी fluent English? कैसे बेटा कैसे? [Wow Shobhit son! So fluent English after passing 8th? How son, how?] Speaker A: English Seekho app की वजह से मैम। [Because of English Seekho app, ma'am.] Speaker B: English Seekho app? ये क्या है? [English Seekho app? What is this?] Speaker A: English Seekho app spoken English का बेस्ट ऐप है, जहां एक्सपर्ट से पहले मैंने एकदम बेसिक लेवल से वर्ड टू वर्ड जोड़कर सेंटेंस बनाने से लेकर उसे फ्लूएंटली इंग्लिश में कैसे बोलना है, बहुत ही आसान भाषा में सीखा। और फिर AI कोच के साथ डेली स्पोकन इंग्लिश की प्रैक्टिस करके अपनी इंग्लिश को फर्राटेदार बना लिया। अब मैं किसी से भी फर्राटेदार इंग्लिश में बात कर सकता हूं। [English Seekho app is the best spoken English app, where I first learned from experts in a very easy language, from basic level word-to-word sentence making to speaking it fluently in English. And then by practicing daily spoken English with an AI coach, I made my English fluent. Now I can speak fluent English with anyone.] Speaker B: अरे वाह! I give you 50% scholarship on fees for your English. [Oh wow! I give you 50% scholarship on fees for your English.] Speaker A: मैम, "I give you" नहीं, "I will give you a 50% scholarship on the fees for your English." मैम, आप भी English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड कर ही लीजिए अब। [Ma'am, not "I give you", "I will give you a 50% scholarship on the fees for your English." Ma'am, you should also download the English Seekho app now.] Speaker B: Shut up! अभी डाउनलोड करती हूं बेटा, English Seekho ऐप। [Shut up! I will download it right now son, English Seekho app.] Speaker C (Voiceover): तो इंस्टॉल बटन पर क्लिक करो और English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho. INSTALL NOW. Disclaimer: English Seekho kisi bhi government authority, institution, brand, organisation ya individual ke dwara endorsed, sponsored, affiliated ya associated nahi hai...
summary: A schoolboy impresses a teacher with his fluent English, explaining he learned it using the English Seekho app. When the teacher makes a grammatical error, the boy corrects her and advises her to download the app as well. The ad concludes with a call to action to install the app.
